Walter S. Masterman, The Wrong Letter.
Standard Ebooks edition: https://standardebooks.org/ebooks/walter-s-masterman/the-wrong-letter

People whose words are in the text, and their death years:
- Walter S. Masterman, the author, died 1946.
- G. K. Chesterton, the writer of the preface, died 1936.

First publication of the text used: 1926 (SE colophon: 'The Wrong Letter was published in 1926 by Walter S. Masterman.')

Why this is public domain:
- United States: the text was first published in 1926, before 1931;
  a published work enters the United States public domain 95 years after
  publication, so this work entered it in 2021.
- Country of origin: the facts do not name the country of first publication. The possible countries are the United Kingdom, Ireland, the United States, Canada, Australia, New Zealand, India and South Africa. Each of them has a term of life + 70 years or less. The last person to die did so in 1946, so the work is public domain in each of these countries.

The edition's own statement of rights (from the repository's content.opf):
"The source text and artwork in this ebook are believed to be in the United States public domain; that is, they are believed to be free of copyright restrictions in the United States. They may still be copyrighted in other countries, so users located outside of the United States must check their local laws before using this ebook. The creators of, and contributors to, this ebook dedicate their contributions to the worldwide public domain via the terms in the [CC0 1.0 Universal Public Domain Dedication](https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/)."
